idea-plugin.name: Downstream Call Graph
idea-plugin.description:
Downstream Call Graph visualizes downstream (callee) relationships for any Java method, showing what methods are called recursively, and lets you jump straight to definitions or call sites.

How to use

  1. Right-click on a method and select Generate Downstream Call Graph from the context menu
  2. Open DownstreamCallGraph tool window (View -> Tool Windows -> DownstreamCallGraph), place your caret on any Java method, and click the Generate button
  3. Use keyboard shortcut Alt+Shift+D (Option+Shift+D on macOS) while your caret is on a method
  4. Explore the graph: Click nodes to open methods, click edges to jump to exact calling lines
  5. Export: Save as standalone HTML or export as LLM-readable Markdown

Key features

  • Downstream (callee) call graph visualization with hierarchical layout
  • Configurable max depth for recursive traversal
  • Filters library/JDK methods, includes constructors and method references
  • Direct navigation to method definitions and call sites
  • Export diagrams as standalone HTML files
  • Export as Markdown with call tree and source code for LLM consumption
